items.summary: When the user tries to interact with the NO button (click, hover, or keyboard focus), it must move to a new position within the visible viewport/container bounds and change its label text each time (use English phrases), ensuring it never renders off-screen or under fixed UI elements.

On the proposal screen, display a clearly labeled "NO" button positioned side-by-side with the "YES!" button (same row on desktop; may wrap/stack responsively on small screens) before any evasive movement occurs.
